caseTitle.zh: 四診合參的第一位病人

tagline.zh: 搓熱雙手再把脈；先看人，再看病
tagline.en: Warm your hands before the pulse; see the person before the disease

desc.zh: 跟著周醫師望聞問切，親手把脈、看舌、寫初診病歷。
desc.en: Follow Dr Chou through the four examinations: take the pulse, read the tongue, write the first-visit note.

desc.zh: 舌診燈、體溫、脈搏與衛教單都在你手上；病人離開診間後的樣子你最清楚。
desc.en: The tongue lamp, temperatures, pulses and the education sheet are yours; you know best what happens after they leave.

about.zh: 把脈前一定先把雙手搓熱。保溫杯裡的桂圓紅棗茶永遠放到涼。
about.en: Always warms her hands before a pulse. The longan and red-date tea in her flask always goes cold.

about.zh: 記得每位病人喝什麼茶。舌診燈的色溫由她管，沒人敢亂調。
about.en: Remembers what tea every patient drinks. The tongue lamp's colour temperature is hers; nobody touches it.

role.en: Fifty-eight, sells vegetables at the morning market

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。凌晨三點起床，站一整天。最近累到站在攤位上都想睡。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Up at three every morning, on her feet all day. Lately so tired she dozes at the stall.

about.zh: 在外縣市上班，靠電話照顧媽媽。鄰居送的補品都先問他。
about.en: Works in another county and looks after his mother by phone. Every gift of tonic goes past him first.

about.zh: 虛構教學個案。喉嚨痛三天，明天期中考。只想要一帖藥和一張准假單。
about.en: Fictional teaching case. Sore throat for three days, mid-terms tomorrow. Wants one prescription and one sick note.

plain.zh: 望、聞、問、切四種方法一起用，互相印證，不靠單一線索下結論。
plain.en: Inspection, listening and smelling, questioning and palpation used together so that each checks the others; no conclusion rests on one clue.

plain.zh: 看病人的眼神、精神、反應與動作，判斷整體的生命力與病情輕重。
plain.en: Reading the eyes, alertness, responses and movements to judge overall vitality and how serious things are.

plain.zh: 精神不振、聲音低、懶得說話、動作慢；中醫認為多見於虛證。
plain.en: Low energy, a quiet voice, little wish to talk, slow movements; in TCM thinking it points toward a deficiency pattern.

plain.zh: 舌邊有牙齒壓出的印子，常與舌胖同見；中醫認為是脾虛、水濕停聚的表現。
plain.en: Indentations along the tongue's edge, usually with a swollen tongue; read in TCM as spleen deficiency with retained dampness.

plain.zh: 沉、細、沒有力氣的脈，要重按才摸得到；中醫認為主氣血不足或陽虛。
plain.en: A deep, thin pulse without strength, felt only on firm pressure; in TCM it suggests deficiency of qi and blood or of yang.

plain.zh: 診脈時手指分三層加壓：輕取、中取、重按，看脈在哪一層出現。
plain.en: Three levels of finger pressure when taking the pulse: light, medium and deep, to find at which level the pulse appears.

plain.zh: 手腕橈動脈上的三個診脈位置，食指、中指、無名指各按一處。
plain.en: The three pulse positions along the radial artery at the wrist, one under each of the index, middle and ring fingers.

plain.zh: 用表裡、寒熱、虛實、陰陽八個綱領整理四診資料，陰陽是總綱。
plain.en: Sorting the findings by exterior/interior, cold/heat, deficiency/excess and yin/yang; yin and yang sum up the rest.

plain.zh: 中醫認為身體的溫煦與推動力量不足：怕冷、手腳冰、疲倦、大便軟、舌淡、脈弱。
plain.en: In TCM, too little warming and driving force: cold intolerance, cold limbs, fatigue, loose stools, a pale tongue and a weak pulse.

plain.zh: 提示可能有危險疾病的症狀，出現時要先排除急重症，再談調理。
plain.en: A symptom that may signal a dangerous disease; when it appears, exclude the serious causes before any regulating treatment.

plain.zh: 把病人介紹給另一科或另一位醫師評估或治療，並寫清楚原因。
plain.en: Sending a patient to another specialty or doctor for assessment or treatment, with the reason written down clearly.

plain.zh: 先整理出病人目前的證型，再依證型決定治法與方藥；同病可以異治。
plain.en: Work out the patient's present pattern first, then choose the treatment from it; the same disease may be treated differently.

plain.zh: 望面色的口訣：中醫認為青主寒痛瘀、赤主熱、黃主虛濕、白主虛寒失血、黑主腎虛水飲。
plain.en: The facial-colour rule of thumb: in TCM, green-blue for cold, pain and stasis; red for heat; yellow for deficiency and damp; white for deficiency, cold and blood loss; black for kidney deficiency and fluids.

text.zh: 病人手腕下墊脈枕，手心朝上，手臂與心臟同高。醫師的手要先搓熱。
text.en: The wrist rests on the pillow, palm up, arm level with the heart. The examiner's hands are warmed first.

text.zh: 望舌要用自然光或標準色溫的燈；有色光源會讓舌色判讀失真。伸舌時間要短。
text.en: Inspect the tongue in daylight or under a standard-colour lamp; tinted light distorts tongue colour. Keep the tongue out only briefly.

text.zh: 宋代起用來教學與考試的穴位模型。診間用它向病人解釋穴位與禁忌。
text.en: A point model used for teaching and examinations since the Song dynasty. In clinic it helps explain points and their cautions to patients.

text.zh: 十四經循行與穴位的掛圖。辨證完要對照經絡選穴時用。
text.en: The fourteen channels and their points. Used when choosing points after the pattern is settled.

text.zh: 秀琴阿姨攤位上的地瓜，紙條寫著「給瘦瘦的醫生」。
text.en: Sweet potatoes from Auntie Hsiu-Chin's stall, with a note: “for the thin doctor”.

text.zh: 表裡定病位深淺，寒熱定病性，虛實定正邪盛衰，最後歸入陰陽。中醫認為它是所有辨證方法的總框架：先問「哪裡、什麼性質、誰強誰弱」，再談臟腑與氣血。
text.en: Exterior/interior locates the depth, cold/heat names the nature, deficiency/excess weighs the body against the illness, and yin/yang sums it up. In TCM it is the frame beneath every other method: ask where, what kind and who is winning before naming organs or qi and blood.

name.en: Why the pulse alone is not enough

text.zh: 脈會被情緒、運動、飲食、天氣、藥物改變；舌會被食物染苔；問診會被病人的記憶篩選。四診合參就是讓每一診替另一診校正，矛盾時才有「舍脈從症、舍症從脈」的判斷。
text.en: The pulse shifts with mood, exertion, food, weather and medicines; the tongue coat can be stained by food; the history is filtered by memory. The four examinations correct one another, and only then can a mismatch be judged.

name.zh: 中西醫整合與轉診紅旗

text.zh: 中醫辨證與西醫檢查不是二選一。喘、水腫、心悸、胸痛、突發神經症狀、不明體重減輕、出血，出現就先排除危險原因；轉診單寫清楚症狀與時間，中醫調理同時進行。
text.en: A TCM pattern and a Western work-up are not either/or. Breathlessness, swelling, palpitations, chest pain, sudden neurological signs, unexplained weight loss or bleeding mean exclude the dangerous causes first; write the referral with symptoms and timing, and continue TCM care alongside.

lines.zh: 中醫診間，早上七點四十分。脈枕還是涼的，周醫師正在用雙手搓熱它。
lines.en: The TCM clinic, twenty to eight. The pulse pillow is still cold; Dr Chou is warming it between her palms.

lines.zh: 早。第一件事不是把脈，是把手搓熱。病人的手腕會記得你的溫度。
lines.en: Morning. The first job is not the pulse, it is warming your hands. A patient's wrist remembers your temperature.

lines.zh: 周醫師早。今天初診幾位？
lines.en: Morning, Dr Chou. How many first visits today?

lines.zh: 兩位。先問你：四診合參，為什麼不能只把脈？
lines.en: Two. First a question: the four examinations together; why not just the pulse?

lines.zh: 脈會受情緒、運動、天氣影響，要和望、聞、問互相印證。
lines.en: The pulse shifts with mood, exertion and weather; it has to be checked against looking, listening and asking.

lines.zh: 對。只靠一診下結論，叫猜，不叫辨證論治。
lines.en: Right. A conclusion from one examination is a guess, not pattern-based treatment.

post.zh: 名單在這：秀琴阿姨八點半，小宇下午兩點。阿姨是賣菜的，一定會帶東西來。
post.en: Here's the list: Auntie Hsiu-Chin at half past eight, Hsiao-Yu at two. Auntie sells vegetables; she will bring something.

lines.zh: 舌診燈先開一下。色溫偏了，舌色就會看錯。
lines.en: Switch the tongue lamp on first. If the colour temperature drifts, you misread the tongue.

lines.zh: 望診靠光。自然光最好，沒有就用標準色溫的燈，別在黃燈下看舌頭。
lines.en: Inspection depends on light. Daylight is best; otherwise a standard-colour lamp, never a yellow bulb.

lines.zh: 記下來：舌診用自然光或標準燈，避免有色光源。
lines.en: Noted: daylight or a standard lamp for the tongue, no tinted light.

note.zh: 望神、問診、舌、脈，四診都到了
note.en: Spirit, history, tongue, pulse: all four done

lines.zh: 秀琴阿姨拎著一袋地瓜走進來，坐下時先嘆了口氣。
lines.en: Auntie Hsiu-Chin comes in carrying a bag of sweet potatoes and sighs as she sits.

lines.zh: 醫生，我最近很累，頭暈暈的，站在攤位上都想睡。
lines.en: Doctor, I'm so tired lately, light-headed. I could fall asleep standing at the stall.

lines.zh: 阿姨還沒開口之前，你看到什麼？
lines.en: Before Auntie said a word, what did you see?

lines.zh: 面色偏白沒光澤，聲音小，走路慢，眼神沒什麼神采。
lines.en: A pale face without lustre, a quiet voice, slow steps, little light in the eyes.

lines.zh: 這叫望神。得神、少神、失神，她是哪一種？進去看。
lines.en: That is inspecting the spirit. Spirit present, lacking or lost: which is she? Go and look.

post.zh: 少神：精神不振、聲低懶言、動作遲緩。這是虛證的第一條線索，不是結論。
post.en: Lack of spirit: low energy, quiet voice, slow movements. The first clue of deficiency, not a conclusion.

lines.zh: 阿姨，您怕冷還是怕熱？手腳會不會冰？
lines.en: Auntie, do you feel the cold or the heat more? Are your hands and feet cold?

lines.zh: 怕冷啊，夏天也要穿襪子。大便軟軟的，一天兩三次。
lines.en: The cold. I wear socks even in summer. Stools are soft, two or three times a day.

lines.zh: 晚上會不會喘？腳會不會腫？
lines.en: Any breathlessness at night? Do your feet swell?

lines.zh: 這幾個禮拜腳踝會腫，爬樓梯會喘，晚上心臟會蹦蹦跳。
lines.en: These past weeks my ankles swell, stairs make me breathless, and at night my heart thumps.

lines.zh: 周醫師沒有抬頭，但筆停了一下。
lines.en: Dr Chou does not look up, but her pen pauses.

q.zh: 阿姨說爬樓梯會喘、腳踝腫、夜裡心悸。這幾句話你怎麼處理？
q.en: Auntie reports breathlessness on stairs, ankle swelling and palpitations at night. What do you do with that?

options.zh: 記為紅旗，問完向師傅提出並建議檢查
options.en: Log it as a red flag, raise it with the mentor, suggest tests

why.zh: 喘、水腫、心悸要先排除心臟與甲狀腺問題；中醫辨證和西醫檢查可以同時進行。
why.en: Breathlessness, swelling and palpitations need heart and thyroid causes excluded first; the TCM pattern and the work-up can run side by side.

options.zh: 寫成陽虛水泛，繼續辨證
options.en: Write “yang deficiency with water overflow” and move on

why.zh: 證型也許沒錯，但紅旗症狀先要排除危險原因，不能被一個漂亮的證名蓋過去。
why.en: The pattern may be right, but red-flag symptoms need dangerous causes excluded first; a tidy pattern name must not cover them.

options.zh: 叫阿姨多穿衣服、早點睡
options.en: Tell Auntie to dress warmer and sleep earlier

why.zh: 衛教是好意，但問診走到這裡要停下來想：這是不是要轉診的訊號？
why.en: Kind advice, but at this point in the history you stop and ask: is this a referral signal?

post.zh: 醫生你問得好仔細。我兒子都說我愛操煩。
post.en: You ask so carefully, doctor. My son says I worry too much.

guide.en: Ask Auntie to show her tongue

lines.zh: 阿姨，嘴巴張開，舌頭自然伸出來，不要用力。
lines.en: Auntie, open your mouth and let the tongue come out naturally, no straining.

lines.zh: 燈我調好了。從正面看，別讓她伸太久，舌色會變。
lines.en: Lamp is set. Look from the front, and don't keep her tongue out long or the colour changes.

q.zh: 舌淡胖、邊有齒痕、苔白。這個舌象提示什麼？
q.en: Pale, swollen, tooth-marked edges, white coat. What does this tongue suggest?

options.zh: 齒痕舌、舌淡：脾陽虛、水濕不化
options.en: Tooth-marked, pale: spleen yang deficiency with dampness

why.zh: 中醫認為舌淡主虛寒；胖大有齒痕是水濕停聚，脾陽不足把舌頭「泡」胖了。
why.en: In TCM a pale tongue means deficiency-cold; swollen with tooth marks means retained dampness, the tongue “soaked” by weak spleen yang.

options.en: Red with little coat: yin deficiency heat

why.zh: 陰虛的舌紅而乾、苔少或剝；阿姨的舌是淡而濕潤。
why.en: A yin-deficient tongue is red and dry with a thin or peeled coat; Auntie's is pale and moist.

options.en: Purple with stasis spots: blood stasis

why.zh: 沒有紫暗，也沒有瘀斑；別把淡白看成紫。
why.en: No purple, no stasis spots; do not read pale as purple.

post.zh: 齒痕舌和望神對上了。還差脈。
post.en: The tooth-marked tongue agrees with the spirit. The pulse is still missing.

lines.zh: 診脈不是一摸就有答案。順序說一遍，再上手。
lines.en: The pulse does not answer at a touch. Say the order first, then put your fingers down.

steps.en: Let the patient sit and rest briefly
Arm flat, pillow under the wrist
Middle finger finds guan, then cun and chi
Light, medium and deep pressure in turn

steps.zh: 兩手都診，各診一段時間
steps.en: Both wrists, each for a proper while

steps.zh: 記錄脈位、脈率、脈形、脈勢
steps.en: Record depth, rate, shape and strength

post.zh: 阿姨剛騎車從市場過來，讓她喘口氣再把，不然脈會跑。
post.en: Auntie just cycled over from the market. Let her catch her breath first, or the pulse will lie.

lines.zh: 阿姨，手放上來，手心朝上，放鬆。
lines.en: Auntie, rest your hand here, palm up, and relax.

lines.zh: 寸關尺三指用指目，不是指腹。浮中沉慢慢加壓，別一下壓死。
lines.en: Cun, guan and chi under the fingertips, not the pads. Light, medium and deep pressure slowly; never crush it at once.

post.zh: 指下別急著下結論，先感覺它在哪一層出現。
post.en: Don't rush to name it. Feel first at which level it appears.

lines.zh: 你閉上眼睛。輕取摸不到，中取隱約，重按才有一條細細軟軟的脈。
lines.en: You close your eyes. Nothing on light pressure, a hint at medium, and only on deep pressure a thin, soft thread.

q.zh: 重按才摸得到，細而無力。這是什麼脈？
q.en: Felt only on deep pressure, thin and without strength. Which pulse is this?

options.zh: 弱脈：沉細無力，主氣血不足、陽虛
options.en: Weak pulse: deep, thin, forceless; qi-blood or yang deficiency

why.zh: 中醫認為陽氣不足推不動脈，所以脈沉而軟弱；配合畏寒、舌淡，陽虛的判斷更穩。
why.en: In TCM, insufficient yang cannot drive the pulse, so it sinks and softens; with cold intolerance and a pale tongue, yang deficiency stands firmer.

why.zh: 浮脈輕取即得，數脈快；阿姨的脈是沉下去才有，而且不快。
why.en: A floating pulse is there at a touch and a rapid one is fast; Auntie's appears only deep, and it is not fast.

why.zh: 弦脈像按琴弦，端直有力；這條脈是軟的。
why.en: A wiry pulse feels like a taut string, straight and firm; this one is soft.

post.zh: 少神、齒痕舌、弱脈，問診怕冷便溏。四診合參，總綱是什麼？
post.en: Lack of spirit, tooth-marked tongue, weak pulse, cold intolerance and loose stools. Four examinations together: the summary?

post.zh: 八綱辨證就是這樣用的。但她還說了一句話，你沒忘吧？
post.en: That is the eight principles at work. But she said one more thing. You haven't forgotten?

note.zh: 人參茶先收起來，轉診單寫好了
note.en: Ginseng tea put away, referral written

guide.en: Take the call at the desk

sub.zh: 鄰居送的人參茶，媽媽可以喝嗎？
sub.en: A neighbour gave Mum ginseng tea; can she drink it?

lines.zh: 醫生，鄰居送我媽一盒人參茶，說補氣。她今天可以開始喝嗎？
lines.en: Doctor, a neighbour gave Mum a box of ginseng tea, says it boosts qi. Can she start today?

lines.zh: 先別喝。辨證還沒定案前自己進補，可能補錯方向。麻煩把盒子帶來。
lines.en: Not yet. Taking tonics before the pattern is settled can push the wrong way. Please bring the box in.

lines.zh: 還有，她這幾天晚上要墊兩個枕頭才睡得著，躺平會喘。
lines.en: Also, these past nights she needs two pillows to sleep. Lying flat makes her breathless.

lines.zh: 你把這句話寫下來，畫了兩個圈。
lines.en: You write that down and circle it twice.

lines.zh: 這很重要，我馬上跟周醫師說。
lines.en: That matters. I'll tell Dr Chou right now.

lines.zh: 你早上就把喘和腳腫記成紅旗了，現在加上躺平會喘，今天就轉診。
lines.en: You logged the breathlessness and swelling as a red flag this morning. Add breathlessness lying flat, and we refer today.

lines.zh: 中醫可以同時調理，但心臟和甲狀腺要先讓西醫看。轉診單你來寫。
lines.en: TCM care continues alongside, but the heart and thyroid go to Western medicine first. You write the referral.

lines.zh: 早上她說喘、腳腫、心悸，你寫了陽虛水泛就往下走了。
lines.en: This morning she said breathless, swollen, palpitations, and you wrote yang deficiency with water overflow and moved on.

lines.zh: ……我把症狀套進證型，沒停下來想紅旗。
lines.en: …I fitted the symptoms into a pattern and never stopped to think red flag.

lines.zh: 證名不是保護傘。現在補救：轉診心臟科，病歷補上紅旗。問診走到紅旗，要停。
lines.en: A pattern name is not an umbrella. Fix it now: refer to cardiology and add the red flag to the note. When the history reaches a red flag, you stop.

lines.zh: 轉診原因：勞力性喘、下肢水腫、端坐呼吸、心悸，建議心臟與甲狀腺評估。
lines.en: Reason for referral: exertional breathlessness, leg swelling, orthopnoea, palpitations; cardiac and thyroid assessment requested.

lines.zh: 很好。轉診不是把病人推出去，是把危險的那一塊交給對的人，其他的我們一起顧。
lines.en: Good. A referral is not pushing a patient away; it hands the dangerous part to the right person while we look after the rest together.

note.zh: 八綱寫上白板，銅人複習取穴
note.en: Eight principles on the board, points on the bronze figure

lines.zh: 周醫師的保溫杯裡是桂圓紅棗茶，從早上到現在一口沒喝。
lines.en: Dr Chou's flask holds longan and red-date tea, untouched since morning.

lines.zh: 八綱：表裡、寒熱、虛實、陰陽。前六個是分析，陰陽是總綱。
lines.en: Eight principles: exterior-interior, cold-heat, deficiency-excess, yin-yang. The first six analyse; yin and yang sum up.

lines.zh: 阿姨是裡、虛、寒，歸陰。小宇下午來，你猜會是哪一邊？
lines.en: Auntie is interior, deficient, cold: yin. Hsiao-Yu comes this afternoon. Which side, do you guess?

lines.zh: 看了才知道。
lines.en: I'll know when I've looked.

lines.zh: 這個回答我給滿分。
lines.en: Full marks for that answer.

guide.zh: 在銅人上指出溫補要穴

lines.zh: 順便問你：阿姨這種脾腎陽虛，臨床常灸哪裡？在銅人上指給我看。
lines.en: While we're here: for spleen-kidney yang deficiency like Auntie's, where is moxa commonly applied? Show me on the bronze figure.

q.zh: 指出常用的溫補要穴：足三里、關元、氣海
q.en: Point out the common warming points: ST36, CV4, CV6

post.zh: 關元、氣海在小腹，孕婦慎用。取穴的禁忌和取穴本身一樣重要。
post.en: CV4 and CV6 sit on the lower abdomen; caution in pregnancy. A point's cautions matter as much as the point.

note.en: One cold, one hot; one deficient, one excess

lines.zh: 小宇戴著口罩進來，聲音沙啞，臉頰紅得像剛跑完操場。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yu comes in masked, hoarse, cheeks as red as if he had just run laps.

lines.zh: 醫生，我喉嚨痛三天，口很渴，一直想喝冰的。明天要期中考。
lines.en: Doctor, sore throat for three days, really thirsty, craving cold drinks. Mid-terms tomorrow.

lines.zh: 先望色。五色主病，他臉上是哪一色？
lines.en: Colour first. Five colours, five patterns: which is on his face?

post.zh: 赤色主熱。配上聲音高亢、口渴喜冷飲，和早上的阿姨正好是兩個極端。
post.en: Red means heat. With a loud voice and a thirst for cold drinks, he is the opposite pole to this morning's Auntie.

lines.zh: 小宇，咳嗽嗎？痰什麼顏色？大便呢？
lines.en: Hsiao-Yu, any cough? What colour is the phlegm? And your bowels?

lines.zh: 有點咳，痰黃黃的。大便三天沒上，口氣我自己都聞得到。
lines.en: A bit of a cough, yellow phlegm. No bowel movement for three days, and I can smell my own breath.

lines.zh: 聞診兩件事：聽聲音、嗅氣味。他聲音高、口氣濁，都是熱象。
lines.en: Listening and smelling: his voice is loud and his breath heavy, both signs of heat.

lines.zh: 那他的八綱呢？
lines.en: So, his eight principles?

lines.zh: 表證未盡、裡熱已起，實證、熱證，屬陽。
lines.en: Exterior not yet cleared, interior heat begun; excess, heat; yang.

q.zh: 咽痛的病人，哪一種情況要立刻轉急診，不留在中醫診間？
q.en: A patient with a sore throat: which situation goes straight to the emergency department?

options.zh: 吞嚥困難、流口水、張口困難或呼吸費力
options.en: Can't swallow, drooling, can't open the mouth, laboured breathing

why.zh: 這些提示深頸部感染或氣道受威脅，是急症紅旗，馬上轉診。
why.en: These suggest a deep neck infection or a threatened airway: an emergency red flag, refer at once.
A heat sign, not an emergency.

options.en: No bowel movement for three days

why.zh: 便秘要處理，但不是今天跑急診的理由。
why.en: Constipation needs attention, but it is not today's reason for the emergency department.

post.zh: 我吞得下，就是痛。可以不用去急診吧？
post.en: I can swallow, it just hurts. I don't need the emergency room, right?

post.zh: 可以。但剛才那些情況一出現，馬上去。
post.en: Right. But if any of those appear, go immediately.

lines.zh: 小宇，先量個體溫。
lines.en: Hsiao-Yu, temperature first.

lines.zh: 體溫計嗶了一聲，數字比平常高，脈搏也快。
lines.en: The thermometer beeps: higher than normal, and the pulse is quick.

options.zh: 通知醫師、補充水分、觀察呼吸與精神
options.en: Tell the doctor, fluids, watch breathing and alertness

why.zh: 發燒先評估整體狀況與氣道，再由醫師決定處置。
why.en: With a fever, assess the whole picture and the airway first; the doctor decides the treatment.

why.zh: 用藥要醫囑；護理師先評估、先通報。
why.en: Medicines need an order; the nurse assesses and reports first.
Nobody leaves before the assessment is complete.

post.zh: 發燒加咽痛，中醫辨為風熱犯肺、裡熱已成；西醫要看喉嚨有沒有化膿。兩邊一起看。
post.en: Fever with a sore throat: in TCM, wind-heat attacking the lung with interior heat formed; Western medicine checks for pus in the throat. We look both ways.

lines.zh: 舌紅苔黃，脈浮數。風熱在表，裡熱已起。
lines.en: Red tongue, yellow coat, floating-rapid pulse. Wind-heat at the exterior, interior heat begun.

lines.zh: 很好。治則呢？
lines.en: Good. The treatment principle?

lines.zh: 疏風清熱、利咽。方藥請師傅定。
lines.en: Disperse wind, clear heat, soothe the throat. The formula is yours to set.

lines.zh: 會定。處方是我的事，辨證是我們一起的事。
lines.en: I will. The prescription is my job; the pattern is ours together.

lines.zh: 初診病歷怎麼寫？順序排給我看。
lines.en: How is a first-visit note written? Put the order in front of me.

q.zh: 中醫初診病歷的書寫順序
q.en: Order of a TCM first-visit note

post.zh: 最後一欄最重要。病人回家後靠的是那幾句話。
post.en: The last line matters most. Once home, those few sentences are all they have.

lines.zh: 阿姨的衛教單：保暖、少生冷、轉診單別弄丟、喘加重就急診。我打電話提醒她兒子。
lines.en: Auntie's sheet: keep warm, less raw and cold food, don't lose the referral, worse breathlessness means emergency. I'll ring her son.

lines.zh: 阿姨早上留下的那袋地瓜還在桌上，貼著紙條：「給瘦瘦的醫生」。
lines.en: The bag of sweet potatoes Auntie left this morning is still on the desk, with a note: “for the thin doctor”.

lines.zh: 今天兩個病人，一寒一熱，一虛一實。你學到的不是答案，是順序。
lines.en: Two patients today, one cold and one hot, one deficient and one excess. What you learned is not the answer but the order.

lines.zh: 望神讓你起疑，問診讓你發現紅旗，舌脈讓你確認。少一個，就少一條腿。
lines.en: Inspecting the spirit made you suspicious, the history found the red flag, tongue and pulse confirmed. Drop one and the stool loses a leg.

lines.zh: 保溫杯裡的桂圓紅棗茶，終於被她喝了一口。涼的。
lines.en: She finally takes a sip of the longan and red-date tea. Cold.

sub.zh: 心臟科掛好了，人參茶收起來了
sub.en: Cardiology booked; the ginseng tea is put away

lines.zh: 醫生，心臟科下週的號掛好了，人參茶收起來了。我媽說你把手搓熱才把脈，她記得。
lines.en: Doctor, cardiology is booked for next week and the ginseng tea is put away. Mum says you warmed your hands before her pulse. She remembers.

lines.zh: 謝謝您。如果喘得更厲害或躺不平，不要等下週，直接急診。
lines.en: Thank you. If the breathlessness worsens or she can't lie flat, don't wait for next week; go straight to emergency.

lines.zh: 你關掉舌診燈。明天還有初診，手要先搓熱。
lines.en: You switch off the tongue lamp. More first visits tomorrow; warm hands first.

sub.zh: 四診合參：少一診，就少一條腿
sub.en: Four examinations: drop one and the stool loses a leg
